programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Premieres October 19, 2026 | LIVE every Monday at 6 PM (KST)https://www.showkpop.comPlease catch the reruns!Broadcast Schedule (KST)- Monday: 6:00 PM (Live Broadcast / Premiere)  - Friday: 12:50 PM, 6:00 PM- Saturday: 6:00 AM- Sunday: 10:50 AM, 8:50 PM- Monday: 2:00 AMThere is no on-demand replay available. programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Premieres October 19, 2026 | LIVE every Monday at 6 PM (KST)https://www.showkpop.comPlease catch the reruns!Broadcast Schedule (KST)- Monday: 6:00 PM (Live Broadcast / Premiere)  - Friday: 12:50 PM, 6:00 PM- Saturday: 6:00 AM- Sunday: 10:50 AM, 8:50 PM- Monday: 2:00 AMThere is no on-demand replay available. Please catch one of the scheduled rebroadcasts.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Premieres October 19, 2026 | LIVE every Monday at 6 PM (KST)https://www.showkpop.comPlease catch the reruns!Broadcast Schedule (KST)- Monday: 6:00 PM (Live Broadcast / Premiere)  - Friday: 12:50 PM, 6:00 PM- Saturday: 6:00 AM- Sunday: 10:50 AM, 8:50 PM- Monday: 2:00 AMThere is no on-demand replay available. Please catch one of the scheduled rebroadcasts.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: MOO NO PLAN
programme.desc: A no-rules, real-life food documentary that unfolds somewhere between No Plan and Jun Hyun-moo’s Plan. The show explores local restaurants and hot spots recommended by neighborhood residents. With the production team staying completely out of it, Jun Hyun-moo and KwakTube build their own travel itinerary as they go, venturing off the beaten path to discover hidden gems that locals swear by. ※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SmartBiz Accelerators
programme.desc: Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market. #SmartBizAccelerators #ArirangTV #smartfactory #smartfactoryproject #competitiveness_of_manufacturing #strengthening_competitiveness_of_SMEs #expanding_into_overseas_markets #growth_into_globalbusiness

programme.title: K-Sports Beyond
programme.desc: "Transcend the Limits of Sports — K-SPORTS BEYOND!“ Where the thrilling contest of sweat and passion meets the unrivaled innovation of Korea's sports industry. Beyond intuition, to precise data—transcending all limits! From real-time AI motion analysis and high-performance sportswear to protective gear, smart facilities, and next-gen fitness solutions, we set the new standard for the future of sports. Meet 20 promising Korean sports enterprises expanding onto the global stage! Our passionate hosts and international guests dive into everyday life and the field of play to verify, experience, and showcase the superior technology and craftsmanship of K-Sports in a 100% real variety show. Beyond innovation to a quantum leap! Running alongside the world, [K-Sports Beyond] begins now.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: For the second leg of his African adventure, Clive has arrived in Ghana. Sometimes called West Africa's 'golden child', the country is known for its deep history, miles of glittering beaches and rich culture. Clive’s first stop is the beachside capital of Accra, home to over two million people. It’s packed with vibrant art, bustling traditional markets and high-rise modernity. He heads to one of the world’s biggest second-hand markets to meet the designers giving discarded clothes a second chance. Inspired by his dressmaker mum, Clive tries a bit of sewing for himself. Once he’s kitted out with a great new look, he heads to the studio of Dancegod Lloyd to learn some moves from the man who turned traditional dance moves into viral hits and who starred in a Beyoncé video. Clive also picks up his paint brush to learn more about the unusual art of fantasy coffins, and he compares his mum’s Jamaican smoked fish with Ghana’s best as he meets the young chefs determined to turn Ghanaian cuisine into the next global trend.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: This week the BBC announced more cuts as part of its drive to save £500 million, following on from a series of other budget saving measures over the last few months. Katie and Ros take stock of everything announced so far along with a panel of experts: ex-BBC executive Roger Mosey, MP for Southport Patrick Hurley, Baroness Morgan, former Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport and the BBC Deputy Director General Rhodri Talfan-Davies. And a new Channel 4 programme investigates public attitudes toward disability. The creators of The Experiment have built a fictional care home for disabled people and invite members of the public into the facility to see if they can recognise Nazi-era concepts disguised as modern social care. Producer Nick Parnes and presenter Sophie Morgan join the show.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded looks at the surprising alliance between Meta and Apple, which raises one of the biggest questions facing the AI industry. As technology companies invest hundreds of billions into ever-larger data centres, the two Silicon Valley rivals are backing a different vision: powerful AI models that can run locally on advanced desktop computers rather than relying entirely on the cloud. For years, bigger AI has meant bigger infrastructure. Vast data centres now consume enormous amounts of energy, water and land, while communities around the world are increasingly pushing back against their expansion. But what if there was another way? What if businesses could run powerful AI systems from their own offices, on machines sitting beneath their desks? Host Marc Cieslak is joined by Dr Stephanie Hare, AI expert and author of Technology is Not Neutral, Ben Hatton, consumer technology specialist and AI commentator, and Nate Soares, AI safety researcher and author, for a fascinating discussion on whether Apple's hardware and Meta's open-weight AI strategy could signal a major shift in the future of computing.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Why are record amounts of money pouring into sport? The LA Lakers are starting the new NBA as the most expensive sports team in history after being bought for $12.5bn. Record sums have also been spent on the NFL's Seattle Seahawks and English Premier League teams Liverpool and Chelsea in recent weeks. Is it really being driven by the search for an AI proof investment? Sal Galatioto is the man billionaires call when they want to buy or sell a sports team and he explains why the prices keep on climbing. Leading TV sports rights executive Daniel Cohen, of Octagon Global Media Consulting, explains the impact this is all having on how we watch and how much we pay. Ben Thompson also hears from the billionaire founder and CEO of Fanatics, Michael Rubin, and how fans are continuing to splash out on replica shirts, trading cards and other merchandise.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra muerta a Leann Fletcher, los investigadores usan análisis de salpicaduras de sangre y computación forense para encontrar el motivo de su asesinato: su esposo, estaba teniendo una aventura con la jueza Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1971, John List dejó una nota con los cuerpos de su madre, esposa y tres hijos en el salón de baile de su mansión antes de desaparecer por completo. Los detectives deben resolver el caso, a pesar de tener solo una fotografía desactualizada de List.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En este episodio clásico de Archivos Forenses la serie de crímenes reales más extensa de la historia de la televisión, Eileen y Derrick Severs desaparecen de su casa en un pequeño pueblo de Gran Bretaña y la policía encuentra evidencia de un crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1994, Shannon Melendi, de 19 años, desapareció mientras estaba en la Universidad de Emory. Su desaparición permaneció un misterio durante diez años, hasta que una nueva prueba científica proporcionó una nueva pista sobre Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: ¿Quién fue el delincuente sexual que asesinó a dos muchachos adolescentes en Nebraska? La clave para detenerlo sería la composición única de la cuerda basura que usó para amarrar a sus víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Asesinato en el menú
programme.desc: Cuando el jefe de cocina de un restaurante histórico de Filadelfia fue encontrado muerto, los investigadores entrevistaron a los sospechosos habituales: familiares, amigos y compañeros de trabajo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La hija de Paul Gruber sospechaba que algo malo estaba ocurriendo cuando recibió unas tarjetas de regalo enviadas de parte de su padre, pero escritas con la letra de una persona extraña.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Impresiones fuertes
programme.desc: La esposa de un oficial de la Fuerza Aérea fue encontrada muerta en su cama con una bolsa plástica de lavandería cerca de su rostro.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Durante 15 meses, un asesino en serie estranguló a prostitutas en Florida y luego se burló de la policía dejando los cuerpos a la vista. Las únicas pistas fueron una huella de neumático y algunos hilos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una hermosa joven cayó a su muerte desde un acantilado con vistas al océano. Inicialmente, los investigadores pensaron que se trataba de un trágico accidente.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1990, el cuerpo de Shirley Andronowich fue encontrado mutilado. Los testigos le dijeron a la policía que tuvo una pelea con su esposo la noche anterior, pero la evidencia forense demostró que él no tuvo nada que ver con su muerte.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un caso inusual involucrando la violación y muerte de Nancy DePriest en 1988. Después de que Chris Ochoa confesara, el caso fue cerrado. 8 años después, Achim Marino confesó al mismo crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: De fotografía
programme.desc: Una adolescente de Modesto, California desapareció. No había señales de lucha en su casa y la policía sospechaba que ella simplemente se había escapado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Con un pie en el crimen
programme.sub-title: Con un pie en el crimen
programme.desc: El cuerpo descompuesto de una mujer joven fue descubierto en un canal de irrigación de Bakersfield. Si había rastros de evidencia, se había lavado con el agua.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una estudiante universitaria desaparece, sus compañeros de clase estaban preocupados por la seguridad de ella y la de ellos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Voto de silencio
programme.desc: Una mirada al caso contra Jack Reeves. Unos amigos informaron que su novia por correo había desaparecido. La policía centró sus sospechas en Reeves y, mientras buscaba pistas, descubrió información que lo vinculaba con la muerte de dos ex esposas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En un tranquilo pueblo de Gran Bretaña, un granjero se encuentra con una apariencia escalofriante. Empalado en el poste de la cerca hay una cabeza de cordero cortada y una nota que dice: Usted es el próximo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una niña de 13 años desapareció de su casa en Colorado y la única evidencia que dejó el secuestrador fueron tres huellas digitales en la cortina de una ventana.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un hombre desaparece un año después de haber comenzado una aventura con la esposa de su amigo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Intruso Invisible
programme.desc: En 1996, la policía recibió una llamada de Darlie Routier informándoles de los asesinatos de sus hijos. La policía encontró al asesino tras analizar las salpicaduras de sangre, haciendo perfiles de comportamiento y analizando la llamada al 911 de Darlie.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Después de que aparecen 10 cuerpos en Florida, una víctima – Lisa McVey de 17 años de edad – es secuestrada pero liberada. Ella lleva a la policía al autor del crimen, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El fuego envuelve la casa donde Lori Keidel y sus hermanos se quedaron solos mientras su padre iba a la lavandería. Años después de la desaparición de su madre, Lori le dice a la policía que fue testigo de la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los síntomas parecidos a los de la gripe de una madre y sus hijos resultan ser algo más grave: intoxicación por talio. Después de la muerte de la madre, los investigadores centran su atención en encontrar al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando dos mujeres desaparecieron y luego fueron encontradas brutalmente asesinadas, la policía se preguntó si fueron víctimas de un crimen de odio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando la policía encuentra el cuerpo de Krista Harrison, de 11 años, hay pocas pistas sobre la identidad del asesino. Pero las autoridades están intrigadas por las inusuales fibras naranjas incrustadas en la ropa que se encuentran cerca de la víctima.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Marcado de por vida
programme.desc: Un hombre que había cometido delitos, incluido el asesinato, no fue capturado. Casi 50 años después, los avances en la tecnología y el análisis de la escritura descubrieron al criminal.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Designer Shit

programme.title: Girl Forgotten: What Happened to Brianna Wells?
programme.desc: 17-year-old Brianna Wells was found shot multiple times and left in a South Phoenix alley.

programme.title: Deep Web
programme.desc: Deep Web guides us through the inside story of one of the most riveting digital crime sagas of the modern era.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.sub-title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.desc: Baby Lyssa, who's just turned 18 and is studying to become a bondsman, gets to do some on-the-job training when she helps Dog hunt for Wayne, who's run out on a bond for second-degree assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: In Sickness and In Health
programme.desc: Dog is sick as a dog, but he still must lead the hunt for a fugitive named James. James' girlfriend tries to cover for him, but Dog surprises James in his bedroom and leads him away in cuffs.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: If the Shirt Fits...
programme.desc: Beth buys Dog a shirt with an embroidered chicken, but Dog explains he only wears shirts with pictures of either Jesus or a Harley-Davidson. When it's time to go to work, the team goes after Necia, a fugitive with felony charges pending.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Thief Who Stole Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rock-a-Bye Bounty
programme.desc: Dog and Beth must go after their former housekeeper, Lisa, who's jumped bond. They know this case will be tricky because Lisa knows everyone in the family. Luckily, Beth's nephew, Jason, is visiting and is quickly put to work as the bait.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Father-Hood
programme.desc: Before Tim heads out for a tough day of bounty hunting, he likes to get in a little quality time with his daughter, Summer Rain.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cops and Criminals
programme.desc: After giving a rousing speech to an audience of enthusiastic grade-schoolers, Dog catches up with an old friend, Sheriff Tommy Cayetano, to talk business. Dog's got a tough fugitive, named Mia, to catch and Tommy is happy to lend a hand.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cupid in Cuffs
programme.desc: It's the day before Valentine's Day and love is in the air at Da Kine Bail Bonds--but not for Tapi who has failed to appear in court on theft charges. Dog's plan is to have Leland knock on Tapi's door with a Valentine's gift to draw her out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bonds of Love
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Love and to Cherish
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to catch and despite the time limit, neither Dog nor Beth can resist the opportunity to catch a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bustin' with Justin
programme.desc: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem - Duane Lee is sick.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Run Fugitive, Run
programme.desc: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Vegas or Bust
programme.desc: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket - Heidi and Stephanie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Playing Possum
programme.desc: Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rainy Day Woman
programme.desc: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy, but Dog has the cure; a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead. She was recently spotted during a bust at a local chop shop garage.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ticket to Ride
programme.desc: Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Knows Best
programme.desc: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources - the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond. Then, Brandon's mother decides to revoke his bond because Brandon has an ice habit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Irons in the Fire
programme.desc: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rocky Mountain Roundup
programme.desc: Dog decides to help two of his bondsmen buddies, Dave "Red" Widhelm and "Downtown" Bobby Brown. First up is Red, who has a client, named Alvin, whose bond is $20,000. Then the team goes after Craig, a client of Bobby's whose bond is almost $70,000.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: This One's For You
programme.desc: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby Lyssa Steps Up
programme.desc: The team is still in Colorado, and today Dog starts his day by to giving his kids and crew a sample of their western heritage by taking them horseback riding. This hunt takes Dog back to his old stomping grounds in Denver.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Running on Empty
programme.desc: Dog's time is running out in Colorado. After a month of helping his bail bondsmen friends around Denver, he's got to get his family back home to Hawaii. But Dog wants one more capture before they leave.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Inside Out
programme.desc: Dog kickstarts the search for Jackson, a 240lbs, six feet tall bad boy who has skipped out on a $10,000 bond. Jackson’s apparently at his father-in-law's house, but the father-in-law has info about Jackson that brings Dog to a unique hideout.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Growing Up Is Hard To Do
programme.sub-title: Growing Up Is Hard To Do
programme.desc: With twelve kids of his own, Dog knows how hard it is to keep children on the straight and narrow, especially during their turbulent teens.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Year of the Dog
programme.desc: A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Mystery of Mona Lisa
programme.desc: When Lyssa points out that the fugitive in the next case has the same birth date as Barbara, Dog's recently deceased daughter, the team takes a special vow to capture the young woman.

programme.desc: Tom Foss has traveled around the world entertaining our troops. Including 5 tours to Iraq, 6 tours of Afghanistan, 11 tours of the middle east, 4 tours of Europe, 3 tours of the Far East, Greenland, 5 aircraft carriers, support ships and bases all around the United States. While not on tour overseas Foss keeps his foot on the ground as a regular at the Improvs, Funnybones and the world famous Hollywood Comedy Store.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Dennis Gaxiola is one of America's funniest clean comedians. The preacher's son gained notoriety from his appearances with Jamie Foxx on Comedy Central, The Latin Kings of Comedy Tour with Paul Rodriguez, BET's Comic View, Que Locos and the 2010 season Martin Lawrence's First Amendment Stand Up.

programme.title: Drew Barth
programme.desc: Drew Barth is one of the fastest rising comedy stars in the Northwest. Born just outside the city of Seattle, what started as a dare in high school has become a full-time career. Drew Barth has risen through the ranks of local open mics to become a regular performer at comedy clubs, colleges, casinos and private events up and down the West Coast. After making the finals of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Drew Barth spent a great deal of time in Los Angeles performing at clubs such as The Comedy Store, Laugh Factory, and The Improv, honing his craft.

programme.title: Eric O Shea
programme.desc: Eric O'Shea has been active in the comedy business for 25 years. He has performed in L.A. with Betty White at the Creative Emmy Awards and has appeared on America's Got Talent TV Show. Every year since 1997, Eric has performed an average of 70 shows a year, and has received 7 nominations as the “National College Comedian of the Year”

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E04 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Paragliding - World Cup
programme.desc: The Paragliding World Cup Superfinal was staged in Roldanillo, Colombia with ten days of high level competition flying in one of the best paragliding venues in the world. One-hundred and twenty-two pilots competed, including 18 previous overall World Cup winners and 12 Women World Cup winners, ranking it as one of the toughest line-ups ever to face each other. Suspended in the air, this adventure sport features cross-country racing, with pilots needing to be an expert in understanding the impact of terrain on weather conditions.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E04 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: World Marathon Challenge
programme.desc: 2020 World Marathon Challenge began on the continent of Africa, on February 6th. The Africa Intercontinental Marathon commenced on the scenic Seapoint Promenade. Unlike other years, the Antarctica Intercontinental Marathon was the second rather than first of the seven marathons this year. Perth, Dubai, Madrid, Fortaleza and a finish in Miami followed this as unique as described World Marathon Challenge. Seven continents in seven days - and the Challenge has completed successfully!

programme.title: Qatar Cross Country Rally - 2020
programme.desc: Manateq Qatar Cross-Country Rally signaled the opening round of the FIA World Cup for Cross-Country Rallies at the stunning, awe-inspiring state of Qatar. Organised by the Qatar Motor and Motorcycle Federation (QMMF), the event has attracted 33 teams and competitors from 17 nations. Five days of intense competition and 1,444.99 kilometres in the challenging Qatar desert, will test cars and drivers to their limits. Although the event has attracted many teams and competitors, the 3-time Dakar winner Nasser Saleh Al-Attiyah stands out prominently. Al-Attiyah has proven to be a force to be reckoned within the cross-country rally scene. Only just missing the mark in the last Dakar Rally, the born and bred Qatari will be keen to compete and impress on home soil.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Charlotte follows Lewis to Max Hamilton. Max tells all to Charlotte when he discovers she’s the granddaughter of his one true love. Charlotte and Lewis almost break up until she goes to the moonpool, becoming a mermaid herself!

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: The girls have to deal with a fourth mermaid who turns out to be a loose cannon; Charlotte almost turns into a mermaid at a volleyball competition. Charlotte discovers she has all three mermaid superpowers.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: As the girls continue to have problems accommodating Charlotte as a mermaid, Nate bullies Lewis. Despite the girls’ attempts to keep Charlotte under control, she uses her powers on Nate and almost exposes them all.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Charlotte takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis, annoying Rikki. At the party, Charlotte is jealous of Cleo and traps her and Emma in a pool room. Rikki comes back just in time. From now on, Charlotte is on her own.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: The Awakening
programme.desc: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programme.desc: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programme.desc: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Big Ideas
programme.desc: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Bella attempts to start a relationship with Will until she sees he's apparently got another girl. Lewis tests the magic Moon Pool water at school and attracts the attention of their Science teacher.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families
programme.desc: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha, until Cleo encourages him to pursue it. Will's sister, Sophie, competes with Bella for a job at the café and sets her sights on Zane.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Kidnapped
programme.desc: Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Revealed
programme.desc: Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programme.desc: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programme.sub-title: To Have and to Hold Back
programme.desc: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programme.desc: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programme.desc: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programme.desc: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programme.desc: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Breakaway
programme.desc: Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life. Rikki sees Sophie kissing Zane at the event and breaks off their relationship.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein schickes Angebot
programme.desc: Die Eliteschule Briarwood zieht in Erwägung, Carly ein Stipendium anzubieten. Carly ist sich nicht sicher, ob sie dieses Angebot annehmen soll. Doch Sam und Freddie wissen, sie müssen Carlys Meinung ändern.

programme.title: iCarly: Fechten wir's aus!
programme.desc: Freddie braucht eine Auszeit von den Mädchen. Daher ist er Spencer mehr als dankbar, als er ihn fragt, ob er mit zum Fechten kommen möchte. Allerdings wird es kompliziert, als Spencer ihn gegen den fiesen Doug Toder antreten lässt.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly TV
programme.desc: Der Programmchef eines großen Fernsehsenders ist auf der Suche nach einem neuen Hit und will iCarly zur TV Show machen. Aber Carly und Co. sind bald enttäuscht von den großen Veränderungen, die der Programmchef durchsetzen möchte.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Dreifach-Date
programme.desc: Als ihr Freund Gibby zu schüchtern ist, ein Mädchen, welches er toll findet, um eine Verabredung zu bitten, beschließen Carly und Co. eine Gewinnshow zu machen, bei der er ein Date gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly wird von den iWeb Awards auserwählt, in Japan für den Preis der Besten Comedy anzutreten. Carly, Sam und Freddie proben für den Auftritt einen Extra-Sketch ein und reisen zusammen mit Spencer und Mrs. Benson nach Japan.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 2
programme.desc: Da der Flieger nicht in Japan landet, müssen Carly und Co. mit dem Fallschirm abspringen, um zu den iWeb Awards zu kommen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen, bis sie auf Kyoko und Yuki treffen, die eine gemeinen Plan verfolgen.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 3
programme.desc: Nachdem Kyoko und Yuki Carly und Co. im Nirgendwo ausgesetzt haben, laufen die Drei völlig verzweifelt durch die Gegend. Spencer und Mrs. Benson, die sich befreit haben, versuchen, die Kids zu finden. Schaffen sie es rechtzeitig, Carly zu finden?

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

programme.title: iCarly: Raus aus den Schulden
programme.desc: Sam ist beschämt als Freddie und Carly ihr sagen, wieviel Geld sie ihnen bereits schuldig ist. Sam versucht alles, um es ihnen zurückzuzahlen. Sie überlegt sogar, sich einen richtigen Job zu beschaffen.

programme.title: iCarly: Achtung, böser Stiefvater!
programme.desc: Bei iCarly startet mal wieder die Rubrik 'Jetzt zeigen wir's Lewbert'. Dabei wird Lewbert durch eine Explosion verletzt. Die Kids wollen den Protier wieder gesund pflegen. Doch dann springt Mrs. Benson ein und es kommt zu einer kleinen Romanze.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokosnusscremtorte
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. Freddie zu ihrem Lieblingskuchenladen bringen, erfahren sie, dass der Besitzer verstorben ist und auch seine Rezepte eventuell für immer verloren sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gut geküsst ist halb gewonnen
programme.desc: Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite.

programme.title: iCarly: Auto oder Aus
programme.desc: Jeffrey, angeblich Sohn von Autohändler Mr. Flanken, will bei iCarly ein Preisausschreiben starten. Der erste Preis, ein neues Auto, soll von seinem Vater gestiftet werden. Nevel gewinnt den Preis, nur stellt sich die Frage, ob es das Auto wirklich gibt.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!
programme.desc: Nevel hat sich die iCarly-URL unter den Nagel gerissen und will sie nur zurückgeben, wenn Carly ihn küsst. Unterdessen hat Spencer versehentlich 200 Kissen bestellt, doch Spencer weiß, wie man aus dieser Situation das Beste macht.

programme.title: iCarly: Spind 239
programme.desc: Sam und Freddie haben bei einem schulinternen Wettbewerb gemeinsam den begehrten Spind 239 gewonnen. Doch das Teilen will nicht so recht klappen. Carly bekommt von Spencer Kunstunterricht.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Die iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly und Co. verleihen zehn 'iCarly Awards'. Spencer sollte die Statuen basteln, doch der hat versehentlich eine Riesenstatue gebaut. Um auf die Schnelle zehn Gewinne zusammenzuschustern, holt er sich sechs europäische Bademodenmodels zur Hilfe.

programme.title: iCarly: Die doppelte Sam
programme.desc: Freddie versucht zu beweisen, dass Melanie, Sam's Zwillingsschwester, nur ausgedacht ist. Um Sam zu enttarnen, bittet Freddie Melanie um ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 2
programme.desc: Griffin, ein Junge, der ins Haus gezogen ist, 'borgt' sich Spencers Motorrad, um damit eine Spritztour zu machen. Der Diebstahl fliegt auf und anstatt ihn anzuzeigen, nimmt sich Spencer seiner an und bringt ihm etwas Bildhauerei bei.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Schädel von Charles Dingo
programme.desc: Bei der Show 'Totally Teri' tauchen Showsegmente von iCarly auf. Carly und Co. finden heraus, dass die Autoren der Show die Inhalte geklaut haben. Carly, Sam und Freddie überreden Spencer, sie nach Hollywood zu bringen, um diese Sache aufzuklären.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Kuss
programme.desc: Als Sam versehentlich vor Carly enthüllt, dass sie und Freddie sich heimlich geküsst gehaben, konfrontiert Carly die beiden damit, um herauszufinden, wieso sie ihr das niemals erzählt haben. Unterdessen gibt Spencer Kunstunterricht im Gefängnis.

programme.desc: The Gosa Gang have recently moved to a new home, close to the Gosa Dam where a rival family of meerkats live. In the quest for territorial dominance, a major meerkat standoff resulted in both gangs losing a member of their tribe.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: Recently Priscilla bought an adopted boy pup from a rival gang to the Gosa Burrow. Unfortunately, his acceptance into the Gosa group was far from ideal. The rest of the gang went out and he was left alone at the burrow, struggling for his life.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: Summer has arrived. The Gang move to an area known as the Whispering Forest as it is the best place to find food at this time of year. However, the grass is long and there are several predators lurking such as a leopard.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 6"
programme.desc: The Gosa Gang are on their way home from the Whispering Forest and bump head on into their bitter enemies. To get past them and move over the mountain a full-on war breaks out.

programme.title: Adaptable Animals S1 - "Anything's Paws-sible"

programme.title: Adaptable Animals S1 - "Who Let the Paws Out?"

programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E2 -Escape to the Deep
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E1 -Desert-Adapted Elephant
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E2 -Saltwater Crocodile
programme.desc: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E3 -Orangutan
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle’s master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primate’s natural engineering prowess.
